title: Corey Haines's marketing-ideas skill: picking channels by stage, budget and context
summary: An AI-agent playbook Corey wrote that organizes 139 SaaS marketing ideas into categories and recommends them by company stage, budget, timeline and use case. It teaches shortlisting a few ideas that fit the user's context, then spelling out how to start, expected outcome and resources needed.

principles.text: Start from existing product context and only ask for what's missing.
principles.quote: Use that context and only ask for information not already covered or specific to this task.

principles.text: Don't dump a list. Shortlist a few ideas that fit the company's situation.
principles.quote: Suggest 3-5 most relevant ideas based on their context

principles.text: Fit tactics to real constraints: time, budget and team size.
principles.quote: Consider their resources (time, budget, team size)

principles.text: Early-stage companies should lean on content and SEO, community and founder-led sales.
Pre-launch, build demand with a waitlist that rewards referrals.
Every recommendation should tie to the user's situation and include first steps.
